DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Bronchitis with Acute-on-Chronic Respiratory Failure due to Hypoxemia.

The normal inflammatory markers and lack of consolidation rule out active pneumonia, while your significant hypoxemia (PaO2 52 mmHg) and history of smoking indicate severe chronic airflow limitation. You are currently in respiratory failure requiring immediate oxygen therapy and close monitoring.
